description: Let each window's local chrome sidebar listen for config-reloaded/config-error events (Task 10's hot-reload) and drive window-move drag (the sidebar's `data-tauri-drag-region` invokes the capability-gated `plugin:window|start_dragging`, wired to the config's `sidebar_drag` flag). The chrome is each window's local (App-URL) main webview; content tabs load remote (`http://127.0.0.1:{port}/`) URLs, and this capability has no `remote` block (local-only, the default), so Tauri denies these permissions to remote content by origin regardless of label — the sidebar gets them, a doc's content webview never does. Deliberately carries NO `updater:default`/`process:allow-restart` (curator's own capability file has both): those plugins' permission schemas are undiscoverable to tauri-build here — lector routes `tauri-plugin-updater`/`tauri-plugin-process` through shell-core's `register_plugins` (its runtime feature) rather than depending on them directly in this crate's Cargo.toml (see the workspace CLAUDE.md's shell-core dividing line), and tauri-build's ACL/permission-schema discovery only walks a crate's *direct* dependencies — a transitive plugin behind shell-core is invisible to it, and naming its permission here fails the build outright ("Permission updater:default not found"). chrome-core's self-updater is consequently unable to get permission yet; that gap belongs to the updater/signing task (see lector's CLAUDE.md — the minisign keypair itself is still a placeholder), not this file.
